name: riichiprac 2.5D shell baker
status: Phase 0 skeleton: the tile mesh, the one-material white/blue split, the lighting convention and the six-shell catalogue are declared here. Phase 1 fills each shell's canvas/camera and flips bakeImplemented.

lighting.convention: World axes: +X is screen right, -Y is toward the viewer/human edge, +Z is up off the felt. The key is one virtual light locked to screen-space top-left-front: for each shell it is placed relative to that shell's camera basis, so highlights land on the top/left edges and shadows on the bottom/right in every projection. The azimuth/elevation below are the front-elevation reference; Phase 1 rotates them with each shell's camera. Azimuth 0 fronts -Y, 90 is +X, 180 is +Y, 270 is -X; elevation is above horizontal.
lighting.status: Starting point for Phase 1. The architecture fixes the rule (one locked key at top-left-front plus a weak ambient fill); the numbers are not a verified bake.

shells.role: bottom player's standing hand: upright front elevation with a top bevel and a white/blue resin edge
face-up discards, unrotated meld tiles, and any flat upright tile
face-up sideways riichi discards and called-tile melds; only the 2D glyph rotates
face-down wall tile for the top/bottom walls and the top player's concealed hand
face-down left side-wall tile, sheared/angled inward toward the board centre
face-down right side-wall tile, sheared/angled inward toward the board centre
